meta.source: Brand files supplied by the client (logo PNGs, signage, letterhead, roll-up, social posts) and the Ruyat website mockups (Home, All Services, Service Detail, Contact; mobile, tablet, desktop).

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Brand navy, sampled from the wordmark رؤية الإنجاز. Primary ink on white; the ground of signage, nameplates and social posts.

tokens.name: navy-800
tokens.usage: Navy ground of the services social post; interchangeable with navy-900 for large fields.

tokens.name: navy-600
tokens.usage: Lighter navy for the building-silhouette motif and raised panels on a navy ground.

tokens.name: gold-700
tokens.usage: Deepest stop of the metallic logo gradient. Gold text on white (4.8:1); use for small gold labels on light grounds.

tokens.name: gold-600
tokens.usage: Logo tagline gold. Light theme #94651f (5.1:1 on white, 4.5:1 on ivory-100); dark theme keeps the logo's #a87323 (4.48:1 on navy-900: 24px+ only). For UI text use accent (light) or accent-on-navy (navy). The logo artwork keeps #a87323.

tokens.name: gold-500
tokens.usage: Mid stop of the metallic gradient. Hairline dividers, icon strokes and borders on both grounds.

tokens.name: gold-400
tokens.usage: Bright gold of the mark. Gold headlines, icons and lines on navy (8:1 on navy-900).

tokens.name: gold-200
tokens.usage: Highlight stop of the metallic gradient; the sheen in the mark. Never a text colour on white.

tokens.name: slate-600
tokens.usage: Desaturated slate of the letterhead band and footer text. Secondary text on white (8.5:1).

tokens.name: ivory-100
tokens.usage: Warm ivory of the door-sign and nameplate panels (approximated from photography). Alternate light surface.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Paper white: letterhead, roll-up banner, logo ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Panels, cards and sign faces set on surface.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The contrasting block: the navy slab of a door sign on a light page, a white panel on a navy page.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on surface and surface-alt (light 18:1 / 16:1; dark 18:1 / 12:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, addresses, captions on surface and surface-alt (≥7:1 light, ≥8:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Gold text on light grounds: the second line of a headline, the '+' of a stat, 'View all' links, labels. 4.8:1 on white. On ivory-100 (4.2:1) only at 19px bold or larger. On navy use accent-on-navy.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Solid gold fills: primary buttons, step numbers, checklist ticks, the divider dot, active slider dot. Text on it is on-accent (8:1). Hover: accent-fill-hover.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill (8:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Gold hairlines and column dividers between services; outlines of pills and frames.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Quiet decorative borders and card outlines (FAQ items, dropdown rows). Not for form controls: use field-border.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring, offset 2px: navy on light grounds, gold on navy. Inside a navy band (.ra-navy, header, hero, footer) the ring switches to accent-on-navy automatically.

tokens.name: accent-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent-fill buttons (navy text 10:1).

tokens.name: navy-slab
tokens.usage: Ground of every navy band on a page: header, hero, Why Us, footer, service cards, selected tabs. navy-900 on a light page; navy-600 on a dark page so the band still shows.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on navy-slab (≥12:1).

tokens.name: on-navy-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on navy-slab: hero sub-line, card descriptions, footer rows (≥9:1).

tokens.name: on-navy-line
tokens.usage: Gold-tinted hairlines on navy-slab: Why Us grid lines, mobile menu rows, footer top rule, icon tile borders.

tokens.name: accent-on-navy
tokens.usage: Gold text, numbers, icons and focus rings on navy-slab (8:1 on navy-900, 5.4:1 on navy-600).

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, textareas, tabs and the language button on light grounds: ≥4.1:1 light, ≥4.4:1 dark (WCAG asks 3:1 for controls).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors: message text, error border, error icon (6.6:1 on white, 9.1:1 on navy-900). Always with a written message, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of an error alert; text on it stays ink.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmation text, border and icon (a teal: told apart from danger by hue and lightness). Always with a written message.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a success alert; text on it stays ink.

tokens.name: whatsapp
tokens.usage: Fill of every WhatsApp button (the form's Send on WhatsApp button and the floating button): brand navy, not WhatsApp green. White text and the white WhatsApp glyph on it: 18:1.

tokens.name: on-whatsapp
tokens.usage: Text and the WhatsApp glyph on whatsapp.

tokens.name: whatsapp-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of WhatsApp buttons (white text 12:1).

tokens.name: whatsapp-green
tokens.usage: Fill of the floating WhatsApp button only (sampled from the approved design). Nothing else is green. The white glyph on it is 2.0:1: acceptable only because it is the WhatsApp logo on an icon button with an aria-label; never put text on it.

tokens.name: on-whatsapp-green
tokens.usage: The WhatsApp glyph on whatsapp-green.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Navy shade over hero photos on mobile and tablet so the white headline holds ≥4.5:1 over any part of the photo. Used as the middle stop of hero-scrim.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind an open mobile menu or dialog.

spacing.note: 4px base: the number in a name × 4 = its px. Use only these steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside pills and between a label and its icon.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding; gap between stacked lines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on small screens; list gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; gap between form fields; gap between service cards on tablet.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; button side padding; grid gap between cards on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Tablet page gutter; gap between a section head and its content.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; gap between stacked columns on tablet.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between footer columns on desktop; large stacks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Section padding (top and bottom) on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero and poster margins; bottom padding of the footer on desktop.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Gap between the two columns of a split section on desktop (About, FAQ).

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Section padding (top and bottom) on tablet and desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tags, checkboxes, thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, dropdown menus, alerts: the soft corner of the door signs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards (service, testimonial, FAQ item, contact panel), sign faces, image and map frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and eyebrows, the language button, filter tabs, social buttons.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Circles: avatars, arrow buttons, the FAQ toggle, step numbers, the floating WhatsApp button.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards on light grounds: testimonial cards, contact panel, raised panels.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of a linked card; the floating WhatsApp button.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Floating layers: language menu, service dropdown.

tokens.name: shadow-whatsapp-glow
tokens.usage: The soft green glow under the floating WhatsApp button at 56px, fitted to the approved design: offset down 11.5% of the button, blur 36%, spread 2.6%, whatsapp-green at 38%. bundle.css scales it with size-fab.

tokens.name: shadow-whatsapp-glow-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and focus of the floating WhatsApp button: the same glow, slightly stronger.

tokens.name: shadow-hub
tokens.usage: The Ruyat hub card in PartnerNetwork only: a soft gold halo plus a deep navy drop.

tokens.name: shadow-spark
tokens.usage: Glow on the travelling spark of a PartnerNetwork connector. Decoration only.

tokens.name: gold-metal
tokens.usage: The metallic sheen of the mark. Use for large gold fills and diagonal ribbons only — never behind text.

tokens.name: gold-rule
tokens.usage: The fading hairline with a centre dot under the logo tagline; section dividers.

tokens.name: hero-scrim
tokens.usage: Over hero photos below 1024px: dark at the bottom where the text sits, light in the middle, dark again under the header.

tokens.name: header-shade
tokens.usage: Resting background of the header over the hero (from the website): navy at 60% at the top fading to clear at the bottom, so the logo and links read on any photo. Becomes transparent while the mobile menu is open.

tokens.name: header-fade
tokens.usage: Scrolled state of the header (from the website): a second layer, header height + 3px tall, that fades in over header-shade once the page has scrolled and the header is showing (duration-header-fade). Hidden while the mobile menu is open.

tokens.name: gold-connector
tokens.usage: Horizontal connector line between partner cards (faint at the partner, full gold at the hub).

tokens.name: gold-connector-y
tokens.usage: Vertical connector line in the stacked (mobile) PartnerNetwork.

tokens.name: gold-spark
tokens.usage: The light that travels along a horizontal connector.

tokens.name: gold-spark-y
tokens.usage: The light that travels along a vertical connector.

breakpoint.note: Mobile first: write the phone layout, then add min-width queries. CSS variables don't work inside media queries: write the literal value.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Tablet and up: section titles at full size, 2-column service and footer grids, 4-up stats, 32px gutters, 112px section padding.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop and up: inline nav links, 3-column services, 4-column Why Us and footer, split sections side by side, hero photo beside the text, 40px gutters.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content, gutters included (.ra-wrap).

tokens.name: container-text
tokens.usage: Max width of running text and centred section intros.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side padding on mobile (32px from 641px, 40px from 1024px; set by .ra-wrap).

tokens.name: grid-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid (20px on tablet).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Header height on desktop; 84px on tablet, 80px on mobile. The header overlays the hero (negative bottom margin of its own height).

tokens.name: hero-height
tokens.usage: Hero height on desktop; 820px on tablet; 100svh (min 560px) on mobile.

tokens.name: size-tap
tokens.usage: Minimum width and height of anything tappable: icon buttons, social links, language options, tabs.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inline with text: footer rows, buttons, contact rows.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Standalone UI icons: menu, close, arrows.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Feature icons: service cards, ServiceGrid, Why Us.

tokens.name: size-fab
tokens.usage: Floating WhatsApp button.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Text raised over hero slides and decorative ribbons.

tokens.name: z-fab
tokens.usage: Floating WhatsApp button.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Sticky header.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Language menu and service dropdown.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Mobile menu sheet and its backdrop; dialogs.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons and fields.

tokens.name: opacity-watermark
tokens.usage: The gold mark used as a watermark on navy (hero fallback slide, Why Us).

duration.note: Calm, short motion. Under prefers-reduced-motion keep only opacity changes; no slide zoom, no auto-advance.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and focus colour changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Header hide/show, menus, FAQ expand, burger icon.

tokens.name: duration-header-fade
tokens.usage: The header's scrolled layer (header-fade) fading in and out.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Section reveal on scroll: fade in and rise 24px, cards staggered 80ms.

tokens.name: duration-slide
tokens.usage: Hero cross-fade between slides.

tokens.name: hero-interval
tokens.usage: How long each hero slide shows; pause on hover, focus and when the tab is hidden.

tokens.name: duration-pulse
tokens.usage: One loop of the gold pulse ring around the PartnerNetwork hub; two rings run half a loop apart.

tokens.name: duration-flow
tokens.usage: One loop of the spark travelling outward along a PartnerNetwork connector.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Colour, opacity and most transforms.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things entering: menus, section reveals, the slow hero zoom.
